recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It reconciles the applied Jira and recorded WG vote without broadening the change beyond the one active terminology systems source row.
issue_request: FHIR-46008 was Applied with Persuasive with Modification resolution for the FHIR-core terminologies systems page. It reported that the ISO/IEEE 11073-10101 reference used a withdrawn edition and the final resolution said to update the source hyperlink to https://www.iso.org/standards.html.
initial_application: The current branch already contained upstream commit 1eff8bccf70e43b721f1005002300093ba539aa1 for FHIR-46008, which changed the MDC row label to ISO/IEEE 11073-10101:2020 but retained the direct ISO 2020 edition link. Earlier commits 539a9744918c3ca93856c07e0273f9b520d5bb54 and 2d67fa6bc155cb2b7480455eca4cf6727d1670d5 had moved the link away from the withdrawn 2004 ISO page to the 2020 edition page.
additional_context: Vocabulary WG minutes for 2025-01-27 record that the group could not link to whatever the most recent version is available and voted 5-0-0 to link to the main standards page. source/hierarchy.xml and publish.ini list terminologies-systems.html as the active Code Systems page, so source/terminologies-systems.html is in current build scope.
reconciliation: Changed source/terminologies-systems.html so the MDC row links ISO/IEEE 11073-10101 to https://www.iso.org/standards.html and removed the fixed :2020 text from the link label so the page no longer implies a specific edition while pointing users to ISO's standards page.
source_changes: source/terminologies-systems.html: changed the MDC ISO/IEEE 11073-10101 link from https://www.iso.org/standard/77338.html with :2020 display text to https://www.iso.org/standards.html with edition-neutral display text.
